# bayarea-glam

Recorded 2026-11-11 from glam.stanford.edu (Geballe Laboratory for Advanced Materials,
Stanford Sites template; Crawl-delay: 30). Home of the Condensed Matter Physics (CMP)
Seminar linked from the SLAC seminar index.

- `events-all-rss-*.xml`: 8 items; `<description>` is the host line.
- `events-*.html`: the list. Here the subheadline is "Speaker - Affiliation" and the dek
  the host. Types seen: "CMP Seminar", "GLAM Special Seminar".
- Titles "Coming soon" are placeholders for talks without a title yet (TBA).
- The subheadline separates speaker and affiliation with " - " on CMP Seminar cards
  and with ", " on the GLAM Special Seminar card: 'Minho "Luke" Kim, MIT' (the page
  has curly quotes around Luke).
- No pager: all 8 upcoming events fit on the list.
